title: HSM_KEY_TYPE_* constants have no compile-time check vs WP11_KEY_TYPE_*
description: wp11_backend_wolfhsm.c defines HSM_KEY_TYPE_RSA=0 and HSM_KEY_TYPE_EC=1 to avoid including wp11_keystore.h. These must match WP11_KEY_TYPE_RSA=0 and WP11_KEY_TYPE_EC=1 in wp11_keystore.h exactly. There is no _Static_assert or other mechanism to catch a future mismatch. If someone changes one without the other, key type dispatch silently breaks. Fix: include wp11_keystore.h and use WP11_KEY_TYPE_* directly, or add _Static_assert after defining the local constants.
